_comment: Branch protection config applied to main of every MiraNote-AI repo. Hardened from the dasgpt baseline: (1) `restrictions` empty-allowlist blocks direct push to main for non-admins; (2) `required_status_checks` enforces `checks / checks` (the reusable workflow status name, same string in both .github self-check and target stubs) -- a PR with a red check cannot merge. `enforce_admins: false` retains the ability for owners to use `gh pr merge --admin` in true emergencies, but the status-check gate still blocks them from merging a red PR via that route too. `strict: false` does NOT force PRs to be rebased onto latest main before merge (low friction for small teams).
